pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions are irregularly polygonal with high-frequency serrated edge gradients, exhibiting 'leaf-like' extensions into the corridors. Patch area is significantly greater than the surrounding negative space.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous network of light cream-colored pathways characterized by tri-nodal and quadri-nodal junction nodes. Pixel thickness decreases notably at the transition to the dorsal ridge.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency jagged 1D contour along the superior neck and shoulder margin, indicating a continuous, short-haired mane.
